create_table_evaluator: create a TableEvaluator instance to evaluate table predictions from a HuggingFace dataset using TEDS scoring
run_table_evaluation: run table evaluation on a HuggingFace parquet dataset split and return per-table TEDS scores with row/column deltas
save_histogram_delta_row_col: save a histogram figure showing the distribution of true minus predicted row and column deltas
test_is_complex_table: test whether a Docling table item is complex by checking for cells with row or column spans greater than one
review_dataset_table_evaluation: review the DatasetTableEvaluation result containing per-table evaluations and aggregate TEDS statistics for simple and complex tables
